children: Overview
US pet pharmacy's Q2 revenue fell 19% yr/yr, mainly on lower prescription sales and more promotions
Q2 net loss narrowed from prior year, helped by lower administrative and advertising costs
Adjusted EBITDA loss widened in Q2 from a year ago
Outlook
Company focuses on transforming core pharmacy business and improving profitability at current scale
Company plans to reposition brand, enhance marketing, and improve website to boost customer retention
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year
Result Drivers
PRESCRIPTION SALES DROP - Co said lower prescription medication sales drove revenue decline
LOWER OPERATING COSTS - Co attributed narrower net loss to reduced administrative and advertising expenses
PRODUCT MIX SHIFT - Co said lower gross profit was due to unfavorable product mix and reduced manufacturer rebates
